blocker: P0 profile provenance/preflight/observation/comparability; not safe as real-game competitive measurement prototype

findings.subject: STATIC_PROFILE_PROMOTED_TO_CAPTURED
findings.evidence: Returns SnapshotStatus.CAPTURED for settings.json default, court.json hof_default, and hardcoded standard_sliders without runtime reader. save_id='OFFLINE_DEFAULT', captured_at='STATIC_SOURCE'. test_reader_safety.py positively asserts this false semantic.
findings.impact: R01 source truth contract broken; static defaults can masquerade as observed current game state.
findings.close: Separate STATIC_SPEC/RESEARCH from LIVE_READBACK; forbid CAPTURED for non-game source; counterexample tests.

findings.subject: PREFLIGHT_CAN_READY_WITH_STATIC_DEFAULT_AND_ARBITRARY_AUTH_REF
findings.evidence: Only raw_value None, restore_plan contains rollback_value and nonempty authorization_ref checked. Does not enforce snapshot.status/live provenance, save+scene identity, genuine auth scope, technical_path validation or restore capability. pipeline gives AUTH_OFFLINE_DEV_DRYRUN and raw fallback 50.
findings.impact: Invalid trial may be READY though simulator remains NOT_RUN; unsafe if later bound to real executor.
findings.close: READY must require live verified source, exact save/build/scene/side, binding of authorization to action and verified restore strategy; blocked-source tests.

findings.subject: SYNTHETIC_GAME_METRICS_LABELED_RECORDED
findings.evidence: Hardcoded GAME_E1_SAMPLE_01/2021-11-15 and metrics 0.42/0.48/101.2, with status=ObservationStatus.RECORDED and human_note Initial offline baseline observation; no live collector. R04 NOT_RUN, R05 UNVERIFIED.
findings.impact: Synthetic fixture could be interpreted as real competitive observation and contaminate history/assessment.
findings.close: Mark OFFLINE_FIXTURE and INSUFFICIENT/NOT_OBSERVED, never RECORDED without independently verified game ID+batch+source.

findings.subject: R06_MISSING_SAVE_AND_ENGINE_PATH_COMPARABILITY
findings.evidence: Comparability only checks side/controller/two normalize flags/quarter lengths/base_source_ref, omits save_id, engine_path, trial identity, game build and game source; source-equivalent probe cross-save/cross-path returns comparable.
findings.impact: Different games or engine pathways may be compared despite explicit Stage01 requirements.
findings.close: Bind save/world, engine_path, active build, game identity and provenance; return INCOMPARABLE/UNKNOWN; negative tests.

findings.subject: R08_LEDGER_NOT_DURABLE_AND_IDEMPOTENCY_RESET
findings.evidence: self.committed_keys=set() and self.ledger=[] initialized in __init__, commit_append modifies these in process only; receipt string 'Committed successfully' not persisted to Git/database; second manager allows same key.
findings.impact: F04 durable append and cross-session dedupe not closed; history can be lost/replayed.
findings.close: Use existing append-only data persistence with exact receipt and restart test; no parallel new DB.

findings.subject: R05_UNTRUSTED_STRING_REFERENCES_AS_VERIFICATION
findings.evidence: When receipt.status EXECUTED and any two differing nonempty Getter ref strings are passed, returns VERIFIED and escalates to L3 if save_reload_ref truthy; not actually validates values, hash or durable reload.
findings.impact: An untrusted or fabricated ref can trigger UI/SAVE_RELOAD-like success states.
findings.close: Require authenticated/readback evidence objects, value checks and actual reload receipt to assert levels.

findings.subject: R07_UNEVIDENCED_EFFECT_THRESHOLD
findings.evidence: sample_size>=5 and delta below -0.02 or above +0.02 yields CONFIRMED/REFUTED, arbitrary confidence. No significance/CI/power/baseline control; source Human excludes excessive repetitive match experiments.
findings.impact: May falsely convert weak observational association into confirmed causation.
findings.close: Use improvement/no improvement/regressed/inconclusive with justified thresholds, confounder tracking, avoid causal CONFIRMED absent controls.

findings.subject: G02_SETTINGS_SOURCE_CORRECTION_UNSUPPORTED
findings.evidence: Dossier says settings.json has corrected max_contract_rating default vs min; the file was not modified in candidate and master settings.json still contains min=70/default=40.
findings.impact: Source-grading claim inaccurate and may mask structural discrepancy.
findings.close: Correct dossier, retain UNKNOWN and open source defect; validate source byte provenance.

findings.subject: F02_F04_F06_NOT_CLOSED
findings.evidence: V2 contract claims F02/F04/F06 resolved, but P0-01/P0-03/P0-04/P1-05 persist. PENDING_REVISION correct, however APPENDED lacks durable commit.
findings.impact: Overstates status of old findings and review maturity.
findings.close: Set candidate issue status to OPEN/PARTIAL with evidence; only independently close after tests.

findings.subject: 21_PYTEST_PASS_NOT_13_INDEPENDENT_GATES
findings.evidence: Scope test checks git status porcelain only (misses committed diff); G01–G08 test checks only presence of strings; checkpoint checks path exists; no-game-write checks simulator flag; final test checks schema and resolution claim strings; developer provides 21/21 transcript but no independent original repo execution in this audit.
findings.impact: Unit-test green does not prove evidence provenance, current branch committed diff or game permissions.
findings.close: Add git range compare, evidence content assertions, actual source-based fixture tests, durable history tests; preserve original command and receipts.

findings.subject: E2_E4_ONLY_GUARDS
findings.evidence: Only single-player minutes range, hardcoded roster count, two-team trade cardinality, reject training setter. No Coach/GM/Player business workflows or native capability proof.
findings.impact: E2-E4 should be graded bounded guards, not operational vertical slices.
findings.close: Maintain honest label; defer implementation to authorized task.

findings.subject: G03_AND_G05_EVIDENCE_EXTRAPOLATION
findings.evidence: Normalize field names and runtime mappings unproved yet source uses fixed false/12 values; 2-team transaction evidence does not logically prove 3-team native impossibility; PE/game fingerprint merely inherited fixed literal not verified live.
findings.impact: Research/static claims should remain unknown for engine-wide support.
findings.close: Separate unsupported by current adapter from impossible in engine; require native/current save evidence.
